title: Add test: KITH_DB_PATH bare filename falls back to XDG data dir
description:
What: Add a unit test to kithd/src/config.rs documenting that a bare filename like 'kith.db' (no directory separator) causes Config::from_env to use the XDG-compliant default path (~/.local/share/kithd/kith.db) rather than treating it as a CWD-relative path.

Algorithm:
1. Read kithd/src/config.rs to understand Config::from_env and the line ~99 path check
2. Add test fn config_bare_filename_uses_xdg_default() in #[cfg(test)] block:
   - Set KITH_DB_PATH=kith.db (no slash)
   - Call Config::from_env()
   - Assert resulting db_path ends with '.local/share/kithd/' or similar XDG prefix (NOT CWD)
3. Document the expected behavior in the test name and comment

Defensive programming rules:
- Do NOT change production code — this is a test-only addition
- Test must be hermetic: set/unset env vars around the assertion, do not rely on ambient environment
- If the code does NOT currently handle this correctly, file a separate bug; do not silently fix it in this task

Agent team: single R+I+T agent (one test, one file)

Tests:
- cargo test -p kithd config::tests::config_bare_filename passes
